base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 100 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: The melodic hook spans two bars in 4/4 time (B minor, 100 BPM). Bar 1 starts on beat 1 with an accented pick-up on F#4, stepping down in eighth notes through E4, D4, C#4 to B3, holding B3 on beat 3. Bar 2 features a syncopated rise from D4 on beat 1.5 to F#4 on beat 2.5, followed by an expressive vocal glide down to C#4, leaving an open, lingering rest on beat 4. Vocal phrasing is breathy yet centered, using clean Turkish vowel contours without slurring..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked acoustic guitar establishing the main Bm progression alongside subtle, warm piano chord sustain.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Subtle rimclick and steady dampened kick enter. Melodic acoustic bassline tracks the kick closely, paired with muted fingerpicked acoustic guitar.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Builds momentum with arpeggiated muted electric guitar tone, dynamic snare crescendos, and a rising bass trajectory.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Opens up into wide acoustic strumming, full live snare rimshot groove, active bass, and a clean electric lead guitar carrying the two-bar hook motif.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Short two-bar instrumental restating the hook melody with light kick drum and soft rhythm guitar.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Rhythm continues with subtle shaker additions. Bassline moves counter-melodically against sparse palm-muted acoustic picking pattern.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Builds dynamic intensity with warm organ pad swells, rolling snare rim accents, and driving bass note transitions.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full acoustic strumming, pronounced live snare beat, driving melodic bassline, and lead hook guitar doubling vocal phrasing in octaves.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Strips back cleanly with a shift in harmonic color: mellow Rhodes electric piano and soft nylon string guitar, backed by warm bass playing root-fifth swells.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Expands into maximum energy without genre shift: full live drum kit with open hi-hats, layered acoustic guitars, and ringing electric ambient chords.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Resolves down to fingerpicked acoustic guitar and decaying piano chord sustain, fading softly on a final Bm resonance.
